body.message:
Hi! Hope you’re doing well. I just wanted to let you know that the Wi-Fi signal is quite weak in one of the rooms. Since the router is in another room, the connection there isn’t very good. I also tried using my mobile data, but unfortunately the signal is weak there as well.

I tried moving the router myself, but I couldn’t find a suitable power socket or a better place for it.

I have online classes in that room, so I was wondering if it would be possible to send someone to help move the router. I’d really appreciate it if this could be arranged as soon as possible, ideally today if possible.
